card.name: Cause-and-effect points in explanations
card.fires_on: Small words and commas at the point in an explanatory sentence where the cause or event has just been stated and the result is about to be named. Seen in general science and history prose, e.g. after 'When a fire occurs' or before 'explosion'.

modes.label: Comma after a condition
modes.description: A comma closing an if/when clause, just before the consequence.

modes.description: The word 'the' or a repeated noun right before the thing that results or is observed.
